name: Device template
description: One device type's template, named <MODEL>_Template (#184): everything true of the model itself, one level below a scheme - its settings list by the manual's own groups with none hidden (#183), what it can do (#181, #182), the PRC-023 loadability inputs its settings feed, and the NPCC Directory 4 criteria that attach when the protected bus is declared BPS by the A-10 study. Compliance here is calculated from study values recorded on the primary elements, never switched on per device (the owner, 2026-09-18). Plain code; the definition names its data.
